_original_lore: The Tarantula Beast is Tarantula Broodfather Miniboss.
It spawns rarely when a player doing the Tarantula
Broodfather Tier IV quest kills a spider.
name: 狼蛛野兽 (小首领)

source: The Tarantula Beast is Tarantula Broodfather Miniboss.
loreParagraphs.translation: 狼蛛野兽是狼蛛母巢小首领.

source: It spawns rarely when a player doing the Tarantula
Broodfather Tier IV quest kills a spider.
loreParagraphs.translation: 当进行狼蛛母巢 IV 阶任务的玩家击杀蜘蛛时,有几率生成.
